audit_relationship: Extension of an existing official SDP schema pilot. The team-match limitation was already known; new observed player-season, leaderboard, lineup and player-match-list routes still expose no player-match statistics. Do not describe this as a new provider or repeat the old match-schema probe.
reason: Observed official frontend routes provide team-match statistics, player-season statistics, lineups and player match lists. They provide no matched per-player per-match CBI or expected metrics. Seasonal/team totals cannot be allocated to individuals.
scope_limit: This is a bounded audit of retained frontend routes and responses, not a claim that no other public or licensed endpoint exists.
reopening_condition: A documented public player-match statistics route or compatible export/version with concrete keeper-CBI/expected-statistic values; rerun full existing native/historical gates before applying.
